integration_issues.flow: goal check-in (I practised this today) on parent2 self-journey
integration_issues.issue: Observed in one Playwright run: clicking the button did NOT visibly increment the count ('Not practised yet' → 'Not practised yet') nor disable the button. Backend POST /api/self-assessment/goal/checkin works perfectly in pytest (idempotent, correct response). Likely a race/overlay with the Legal-Acknowledgement modal that occasionally re-opens on navigation and intercepts the click. Main agent should sanity-check that the frontend handler actually fires fetch and refreshes history after click (toast appears + count re-renders).
